policy: Readiness is advisory: builds are permitted, but unresolved checks must be disclosed and do not constitute legal or filing certification.
blockers: The 2026 household threshold, method rules and payroll PIT golden cases are implemented, but the legal matrix still needs independent review and wider boundary coverage.
Enterprise CIT eligibility, exemption conditions, deductible expenses and annual settlement are not release-certified.
VAT product classification, effective rates/exclusions and eligible input-VAT source documents are not release-certified.
SME VAT input must come from eligible source documents; the 70% estimate cannot be a release calculation.
Payroll insurance bases, caps, overtime classifications and 2026 employer obligations need effective-dated verification.
End-to-end accounting workflows and PyQt6/Stable parity are not yet release-certified.
